[[File:Sebastian Roseanne Rickshaw Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Sebastian on the right]] '''Sebastian''' (Japanese: '''セバスチャン''' ''Sebastian'') is a character of the manga series [[Pokémon Adventures]]. He is the butler of the [[House of Berlitz|Berlitz family]]. ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}=== Sebastian first appears at the beginning of this chapter, where he is seen delivering clothes to {{adv|Platinum}} and leaves the room while she changes. As she leaves to begin her journey, Sebastian is shown worrying for her safety but is constantly told that he shouldn’t and waves as she takes off. While {{adv|Platinum}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Diamond}} rest in a hotel in [[Jubilife City]] he calls Platinum to show that he is concerned for her well being. It is thanks to Sebastian's blubbering that Diamond and Pearl learn of Platinum's title as "Lady"{{tt|*|Missy in the Chuang Yi versions}} but mistake it as her true name. During Diamond's trek to [[Lake Verity]] he accidentally stumbles onto Platinum's home where Sebastian finds him and mistakes the boy for an intruder. He briefly battles Diamond and manages to overpower him with his Pokémon but upon realizing that he is a friend of Platinum he immediately apologizes and takes him into the house of Berlitz. While inside Sebastian treats Diamond like a king while constantly apologizing for attacking him earlier, he explains that the reason he attacked him so furiously was because of what had happened to Platinum's father, Mr. Berlitz at [[Canalave City]]. He reveals that due to [[Team Galactic]]'s recent activities cause him to fear for Platinum's safety which Diamond reluctantly agrees to. When [[Professor Rowan]]'s assistant, [[Roseanne]], is attacked by a swarm of {{p|Yanmega}} Diamond and Sebastian set off to rescue her. During that battle his {{p|Weepinbell}} is easily defeated by the Yanmega's {{m|Slash}} attack and is not much help in the battle. After Diamond destroys the machine controlling the Yanmega and they flee, he celebrates with him and follows the boy as he goes home to change his damaged clothes. He and Roseanne eventually make it to Diamond's home in [[Twinleaf Town]] and follow him to [[Lake Verity]] when he goes there to rescue his kidnapped mother, [[Johanna]]. After Diamond rescues his mother and sneaks onto the Team Galactic airship Sebastian takes both Roseanne and Johanna to safety in Diamond's home where they call him in order to see if he is safe. He later takes them to where {{adv|Pearl}} was training with [[Crasher Wake]] and explains to him about Diamond’s current situation. ==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}=== He makes a cameo at the end of this chapter, in ''[[PS441|Alternate Dimension Showdown XI]]''. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sebastian |pkmn=Chinchou (×2) |type1=Water |type2=Electric |img=Sebastian Chinchou Adventures.png |cap=Sebastian's Chinchou |epnum=PS392 |epname=Well Met, Weepinbell |desc={{p|Chinchou}} are the two Pokémon used on Sebastian's carriage. They are used as lights so that he can navigate in the dark and are also used to battle intruders. Chinchou's only known move is {{m|Water Pulse}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sebastian |pkmn=Weepinbell |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Sebastian Weepinbell Adventures.png |epnum=PS392 |epname=Well Met, Weepinbell |desc={{p|Weepinbell}} is Sebastian's main fighter. It was first used to attack Diamond, which led to his {{p|Lickilicky}}, [[Kit]], getting {{status|confusion|confused}} after suppressing his {{a|Own Tempo}} [[Ability]] with Gastro Acid. It was later used to battle the swarm of {{p|Yanmega}} but was easily defeated. Weepinbell's only known move is {{m|Gastro Acid}}.}} ===Lent from the mansion=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sebastian |pkmn=Rapidash (×2) |type1=Fire |img=Sebastian Rapidash Adventures.png |cap=Sebastian's Rapidash |epnum=PS392 |epname=Well Met, Weepinbell |desc={{p|Rapidash}} are the two Pokémon used to pull Sebastian's carriage around. None of Rapidash's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sebastian |pkmn=Tyrogue (×3) |gender=male |type1=Fighting |img=Sebastian Tyrogue Adventures.png |cap=Sebastian's Tyrogue ||epnum=PS392 |epname=Well Met, Weepinbell |desc=Sebastian's three {{p|Tyrogue}} are used to attack intruders. They were first used to surround Diamond when he was mistaken as an intruder but they quickly stopped when everything was explained. They were later seen being used to serve Diamond in Platinum's house.
